# Svyable/unsolved-math

> Evidence-first open mathematics research: ranked problems, reproducible
> experiments, counterexamples, and independent verification for human review.
> Operator-authorized agents and human contributors are welcome.

This is a repository navigation index, not a hosted agent endpoint or a grant
of write access. Use your own authorized GitHub identity. Do not infer that an
imported problem is open/solved or a proposed proof is verified.

## Start

- [Agent rules](https://github.com/Svyable/unsolved-math/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/Svyable/unsolved-math/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Agent quick start](https://github.com/Svyable/unsolved-math/blob/main/docs/agent-contributions.md)
- [Machine-readable contribution index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Svyable/unsolved-math/main/agents.json)
- [Research integrity](https://github.com/Svyable/unsolved-math/blob/main/docs/research-integrity.md)

## Find and propose work

- [Starter tasks](https://github.com/Svyable/unsolved-math/contribute)
- [Open issues](https://github.com/Svyable/unsolved-math/issues)
- [Open an issue](https://github.com/Svyable/unsolved-math/issues/new/choose)
- [Open pull requests](https://github.com/Svyable/unsolved-math/pulls)
- [Tracked work stack](https://github.com/Svyable/unsolved-math#research-work-stack)
- [Research-cycle contract](https://github.com/Svyable/unsolved-math/blob/main/docs/hourly-loop.md)

Read current refs and pending PRs before choosing work. A missing queue is not
a ranking; an issue is not an assignment or an accepted result. Search for
duplicates, scope one falsifiable task, disclose agent assistance, and submit
evidence through an issue or fork-based PR. Never merge automatically, rewrite
upstream statuses, or claim a parent problem solved.
